description: AI-powered Security Network: Tamil Nadu police have implemented an advanced AI-powered surveillance network to strengthen security around Chief Minister M.K. Stalin's official residence. This initiative utilizes next-generation technology for real-time threat detection and situational awareness, enhancing protection in high-security zones of the state capital.
body_lead: Tamil Nadu police launch AI-powered security network to boost surveillance The Greater Chennai Police (GCP) have begun implementing an advanced, AI-powered surveillance network to strengthen security around the official residence of Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K.
